root_cause.text: The RISC-V IOMMU driver omitted required IOTINVAL commands (TLB and context cache invalidations) after updating DDT or PDT entries, violating the specification and risking stale translations.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states the patch "Adds riscv_iommu_iodir_iotinval() to perform required TLB and context cache invalidations after updating DDT or PDT entries, as mandated by the RISC-V IOMMU specification (Section 6.3.1 and 6.3.2)." The patch diff shows the new function and its calls within riscv_iommu_iodir_update() after DDT invalidation, fixing commit 488ffbf18171 ("iommu/riscv: Paging domain support") which lacked these invalidations.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add IOTINVAL command emission after DDT/PDT modifications to maintain IOMMU TLB consistency and fix potential translation errors.
intent_record.what: Added a new static function riscv_iommu_iodir_iotinval that constructs and sends IOTINVAL commands based on the IOMMU specification after modifying DDT or PDT entries, handling various invalidation scenarios (first-stage, second-stage, with PSCID/GSCID).
intent_record.how: This function ensures that when DDT or PDT entries are updated, the IOMMU's TLB is properly invalidated to prevent stale translations. It sends IOTINVAL.VMA commands with appropriate parameters (GV, AV, PSCV, PSCID, GSCID) depending on the mode and whether PDT invalidation is needed, and also plans for future second-stage invalidation (IOTINVAL.GVMA).

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing I/O TLB invalidation after IODIR entry update to prevent stale translations; default to inval_pdt=false and pc=NULL as SVA/PASID not yet merged.
intent_record.what: Added a call to riscv_iommu_iodir_iotinval(iommu, false, dc->iohgatp, dc, NULL) with a comment explaining that SVA and PASID features are not yet merged, so default inval_pdt=false and pc=NULL are used.
intent_record.how: After sending the DDT invalidation command, this new call performs an I/O TLB invalidation for the associated I/O page table, ensuring stale translations are flushed when the mapping is updated.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing IOTLB invalidation after IO directory entry updates to ensure correctness when device mappings change.
intent_record.what: Add a call to riscv_iommu_iodir_iotinval with inval_pdt=false, dc->iohgatp, dc, and NULL inside the loop that updates IO directory entries, preceded by a comment explaining the default configuration due to missing SVA/PASID features.
intent_record.how: After sending the IO directory update command for each device ID, an IOTLB invalidation is performed to flush stale translations, preventing the IOMMU from using cached entries that are no longer valid.
